name: heap v0.4.9
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(oauth): register Sentry as a public client, dropping its secret by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/107
* Ticket enrichment: make a mirrored issue look and behave like one (HEAP-117) by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/108
* Stop a task id from silently destroying another task by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/109
* Stop a tracker pull from undoing what the user decided by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/110
* Let a branch find its own ticket, and stop it finding someone else's by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/111
* Restrict the secrets file, refresh the palette, drop a lying toggle by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/112
* Build one card per task, not one per task per column by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/113
* Stop recomputing what has not changed by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/114


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/compare/v0.4.8...v0.4.9

name: heap v0.4.8
body:
## What's Changed
* docs(pages): readable screenshots + new landing by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/74
* fix(pages): landing fetched a raw {{ }} placeholder; drop build chrome and SRI strip by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/75
* docs(landing): add qt6-networkauth-dev to Linux build deps by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/77
* fix(build): resolve heap_core link-feature clash in QML tests by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/78
* HEAP-104: sync cascade-delete, any-order datetime parse, sync-comment context, column scrollbar by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/79
* HEAP-104: harden the task data model for lossless, time-aware persistence by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/76
* test(qml): full component coverage + 10 confirmed bug fixes by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/80
* fix(ui): visual bugs, dead hit targets and the RU/EN mix by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/81
* fix(integrations): make the trackers actually connect and sync by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/82
* feat(cli): add --data-dir so a run can use a throwaway profile by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/83
* build: vendor md4c as a static library by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/84
* feat(markdown): parse notes into an AST that knows its source lines by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/85
* feat(markdown): outline, callouts, footnotes and rich-text rendering by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/86
* feat(notes): draw the parsed document instead of handing it to Qt by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/87
* feat(notes): make the rendered view answer back by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/88
* feat(notes): give the editor markdown keys, and move the rules into C++ by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/89
* feat(notes): replace the editor's line-by-line highlighting by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/90
* docs(notes): describe the editor that now exists by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/91
* perf(git): stop freezing the window while a branch is created by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/92
* fix(integrations): actually refresh expired OAuth tokens by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/93
* feat(integrations): hand-rolled OAuth engine for every provider dialect by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/94
* feat(integrations): browser sign-in for Todoist, Asana, ClickUp, Sentry, Bitbucket by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/95
* feat(integrations): browser sign-in for Jira and Trello by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/96
* docs(help): in-app guide for integrations by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/97
* feat(integrations): Mattermost directory — sign in and fetch contacts by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/98
* feat(integrations): import Mattermost contacts into Docs and the People rail by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/99
* fix(jira): a pasted ticket URL broke the base URL, and a 401 said nothing by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/100
* fix(integrations): crash, credential leaks and a dead Trello flow by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/101
* feat(jira): support Server and Data Center by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/102
* docs(oauth): a step-by-step setup guide, and fix two things it exposed by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/103
* docs(oauth): correct the setup guide against the live consoles by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/104
* docs(oauth): Sentry rotates its client secret, it does not need recreating by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/105
* fix(oauth): stop asking Trello users for an API key the sign-in supplied by @sectapunterx in https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/pull/106


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sectapunterx/heap/compare/v0.4.7...v0.4.8
